name: com.stormdue/stormdue
title: StormDue stormwater permit facts
description: Read-only US industrial stormwater permit facts: state permits, industry coverage, no-exposure.

tools.name: list_states
tools.description: Lists every US state, territory and DC with its industrial stormwater permit, the agency that runs it, the official link and whether StormDue lists its duties. Use get_state_permit for one state.

tools.name: get_state_permit
tools.description: Returns one state's industrial stormwater permit: agency, permit name and number, effective and expiry dates, the official page, where facilities file, and whether StormDue lists its duties. Each cell carries a confidence mark: (C) confirmed from the agency page, (I) inferred, (U) not checked.

state.description: US state, territory or DC: a two-letter USPS code (e.g. "CA") or the name (e.g. "California").

tools.name: check_industry_coverage
tools.description: Given a 4-digit SIC code (or words such as "scrap metal recycling", or a 2-3 digit SIC prefix), returns the SIC title, the federal industrial-activity category of 40 CFR 122.26(b)(14) that lists it, and the EPA 2021 MSGP sector and subsector (Appendix D), each with a proof link. Words or prefixes return matching codes to choose from. It reports what the lists say; it never decides whether a facility needs a permit.

query.description: A 4-digit SIC code such as "5093", a 2-3 digit SIC prefix, or words from the industry name.

tools.name: no_exposure_checklist
tools.description: Without answers: returns the eleven exposure questions of 40 CFR 122.26(g)(4)(iii) (the same as EPA's No Exposure Certification form) with their limits. With answers: returns "may_certify" (every item "no": the facility may be able to certify no exposure; confirm with the agency), "exposure" (one or more items "yes") or "incomplete". Optionally give the state for its agency and any state-specific note.

answers.description: Answers to the 11 exposure questions, keyed by item id "A" to "K" (from no_exposure_checklist with no answers). Each value is "yes" (exposed to precipitation now or in the foreseeable future) or "no".

state.description: US state, territory or DC: a two-letter USPS code (e.g. "CA") or the name (e.g. "California").

tools.name: get_permit_duties
tools.description: Returns the recurring duties of a state's industrial stormwater permit with the next due date of each and the next 12 months of dates, each with its permit citation, and each duty's further steps (sub_deadlines) with their own dates or open questions, but only when the permit's rules have passed review. Otherwise returns available: false, the review status, and the state's permit facts. Coverage is "noi" (full permit) or "nec" (no-exposure certification) where the permit has it.

state.description: US state, territory or DC: a two-letter USPS code (e.g. "CA") or the name (e.g. "California").

coverage.description: Coverage type id, e.g. "noi" or "nec". Defaults to the permit's first.
